title: Battle of Moncontour
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Moncontour", at revision 1370450239, opens: "The Battle of Moncontour occurred on 3 October 1569 between the royalist Catholic forces of King Charles IX of France, commanded by Henry, Duke of Anjou, and the Huguenots commanded by Gaspard II de Coligny." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q591727, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1569 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
